resources.name: Isobaric heat capacity data for BeO from Victor & Douglas 1963

access.notes: J. Res. Nat. Bur. Stand., Ser. A: Phys. Chem. 67, 325 (1963). Provides experimental Cp(T) data.

resources.name: Thermophysical properties of BeO from Krzhizhanovskii & Shtern 1973

access.notes: R.E. Krzhizhanovskii and Z.Yu. Shtern, 'Thermophysical Properties of Nonmetallic Materials (Oxides)', Energiya, Leningrad (1973). A published monograph; contains additional Cp data.

resources.name: Volumetric thermal expansion coefficient α data for BeO from Sirota et al. 1987

access.notes: N.N. Sirota, A.M. Kuz'mina, L.P. Poluchankina, Dokl. Akad. Nauk SSSR 295, 369 (1987); English translation in Sov. Phys. Dokl. 32, 604 (1987). Provides α(T) data.

resources.name: Standard molar volume V₀ of BeO from Samsonov 1978

access.notes: G.V. Samsonov (Ed.), 'Physicochemical Properties of Oxides. The Manual', Metallurgiya, Moscow (1978), p. 29. Public handbook giving V₀ = 8.25×10⁻³ m³/mol.
